1.label: Vin (Input Voltage)
1.what: The main DC power supply feeding the circuit (5 Volts).
1.mastery: In real circuits, this often comes from a microcontroller pin or power rail.

2.label: R1 & R2 (Series Resistors)
2.what: Two resistors connected end-to-end that split the input voltage proportionally.
2.mastery: Formula: Vout = Vin × (R2 / (R1 + R2)). When R1 equals R2, Vout is always half of Vin!

3.label: Vout (Output Voltage)
3.what: The stepped-down reference voltage tapped from between the two resistors.
3.mastery: Crucial for stepping down a 5V sensor signal so it doesn't fry a 3.3V microcontroller input.
